name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clauses R1,R2,R3 (hard Existence(blocker_moved), Existence(has_door_key), Existence(door_open)) are redundant. The task only requires picking up the ball and the key (to satisfy the precedences) and unlocking the door before picking up the box. The three Existence clauses are already implied by the hard Precedence rules together with the hard Existence(target_picked_up). Remove the redundant Existence clauses and keep only the hard Precedence(blocker_moved, door_open), Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) and the hard Existence(target_picked_up).

texts: The target box must be picked up to finish the mission.
The door cannot be opened before the blocking ball has been moved.
The door cannot be opened before the key has been acquired.
The target box cannot be picked up before the door is opened.
